Since 07 • 04 • 2026

Us, so far ♡

I don't know exactly where this story is going, but I know I want to keep collecting little moments with you — the silly ones, the sweet ones, the random conversations, and all the memories we haven't made yet.

Long distance isn't always easy, but somehow you still make the distance feel a little smaller. Until we can be together more often, I'll keep looking forward to every call, every message, and every moment we get.

Even with the distance between us, you still manage to feel close to me. I hope someday we look back at all these miles and smile because we made them worth it together.

A letter for Aditi 💌

Dear Adi,

If this little website could give you a hug, it would. Since I can't make pixels do that yet, I'll just say this instead: I'm really, really glad I found you.

Thank you for being you. I hope we get a lot more laughs, late-night talks, dumb jokes, adventures, photos, and moments that we'll look back on and say, “remember this?”

Here's to us and everything still waiting to happen. ♡

— yours, always ♡
